newsitem.title: USA: Ross Technology delays Q2, sees Q2 net loss.
newsitem.headline: Ross Technology delays Q2, sees Q2 net loss.

text.p: Ross Technology Inc said Friday that it is delaying the release of its results for the second quarter ended September 30.
The company said it expects the second quarter to be below analysts expectations and that the quarter would see a net loss of about $6 to $7 million.
Revenues for the quarter will be about $20 to $21 million, the company said.
The company attributed the expected net loss to an increase in its accounts receivable reserve, a sharper- than-expected decline in microprocessor chip revenues and other factors.
The company said it expects to release second quarter results November 14.
First Call consensus estimate for the company's second quarter was a $0.01 per share loss.
